recommended_approach: Mantaflow GAS Multi-Flow Domain with Dissolve Smoke, layered with a Particle System for occasional sparks

key_parameters.dissolve_speed: 30 in the Mantaflow dissolve example; the fire-specific campfire pattern also explicitly uses dissolve
key_parameters.resolution_max: 96 in the returned Mantaflow example; use this as the documented reference point when balancing against lower test resolutions
key_parameters.timesteps_max: 6 in the returned Mantaflow example (documented as high for fast-moving fire)

warnings: A fluid simulation needs a Domain object, and at least one Flow object is required.
The domain must have a material assigned for rendering.
Use bpy.ops.object.effector_add() not bpy.ops.object.forcefield_add(); the latter does not exist in Blender 5.0.
The fire-specific pattern library includes a campfire case where smoke accumulates and fills the whole domain; using a multi-flow setup with dissolve is the documented fix direction.
The search results did not return direct API reference pages for every queried fire property, so exact RNA names for some campfire tuning controls should be verified before scripting automation.
alternative_approaches: Particle System emitter for sparks/embers using bpy.types.ParticleSettings with render_type='HALO'
